notes: Official unmodified redis-benchmark and redis-cli only; Python orchestrates Docker and records output.
Warm SET and100%hit GET; stock SET prefill followed byDBSIZE verification.
No workload-specific squash/cache changes; persistence off and eviction disabled for all.
Redis multicore uses8I/Othreads; its command executor remains single-threaded.
Servers run separately; backend order rotates each measured round.
